name: Targeted Strike (Combat)
body:
You are an expert at striking a foe’s vulnerable spots.

Benefit: When you score a critical hit, you can draw one additional critical hit card.

Special: This feat requires the use of a deck of cards for determining the results of a critical hit, and these cards are available from the publishers of the roleplaying game this product supports.
